32 class UnparseSageVisitor {
33 public:
34  UnparseSageVisitor(llvm::raw_ostream &out, int indentationAmount,
35  Encoding encoding, bool capitalize, bool backslashEscapes,
36  preStatementType *preStatement, parser::AllCookedSources* cooked)
37  : out_{out}, indentationAmount_{indentationAmount}, encoding_{encoding},
38  capitalizeKeywords_{capitalize}, backslashEscapes_{backslashEscapes},
39  preStatement_{preStatement}, asFortran_{nullptr}, cooked_{cooked} {}
40 
41  // In nearly all cases, this code avoids defining Boolean-valued Pre()
42  // callbacks for the parse tree walking framework in favor of two void
43  // functions, Before() and Unparse(), which imply true and false return
44  // values for Pre() respectively.
45  template <typename T> void Before(/*const*/ T &) {}
46  template <typename T> double Unparse(/*const*/ T &); // not void, never used
47 
48  template <typename T> bool Pre(/*const*/ T &x) {
49  if constexpr (std::is_void_v<decltype(Unparse(x))>) {
50  // There is a local definition of Unparse() for this type. It
51  // overrides the parse tree walker's default Walk() over the descendents.
52  Before(x);
53  Unparse(x);
54  Post(x);
55  return false; // Walk() does not visit descendents
56  } else if constexpr (HasTypedExpr<T>::value) {
57  // Format the expression representation from semantics
58  if (asFortran_ && x.typedExpr) {
59  asFortran_->expr(out_, *x.typedExpr);
60  return false;
61  } else {
62  return true;
63  }
64  } else {
65  Before(x);
66  return true; // there's no Unparse() defined here, Walk() the descendents
67  }
68  }
69  template <typename T> void Post(/*const*/ T &) {}
70 
71  // Emit simple types as-is.
72 #if PUT
73  void Unparse(const std::string &x) { Put(x); }
74  void Unparse(int x) { Put(std::to_string(x)); }
75  void Unparse(unsigned int x) { Put(std::to_string(x)); }
76  void Unparse(long x) { Put(std::to_string(x)); }
77  void Unparse(unsigned long x) { Put(std::to_string(x)); }
78  void Unparse(long long x) { Put(std::to_string(x)); }
79  void Unparse(unsigned long long x) { Put(std::to_string(x)); }
80  void Unparse(char x) { Put(x); }
81 #endif
82 
83  // Statement labels and ends of lines
84  template <typename T> void Before(/*const*/ Statement<T> &x) {
85  if (preStatement_) {
86  (*preStatement_)(x.source, out_, indent_);
87  }
88  Walk(x.label, " ");
89  }
90  template <typename T> void Post(const Statement<T> &x) {
91  if (auto range{cooked_->GetProvenanceRange(x.source)}) {
92  auto src{cooked_->allSources().GetSource(range.value())};
93  auto size = range.value().size();
94  std::string main{src, size};
95  out_ << main << "\n";
96  }
97  }
98 
99  // The special-case formatting functions for these productions are
100  // ordered to correspond roughly to their order of appearance in
101  // the Fortran 2018 standard (and parse-tree.h).
102 
103  void Unparse(/*const*/ Program &x) { // R501
104  Walk("", x.v, "\n"); // put blank lines between ProgramUnits
105  }
106 
107  void Unparse(const Name &x) { // R603
108 #if PUT
109  Put(x.ToString());
110 #endif
111  }
112  void Unparse(const DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator &x) { // R608
113  switch (x) {
114  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::Power:
115  Put("**");
116  break;
117  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::Multiply:
118  Put('*');
119  break;
120  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::Divide:
121  Put('/');
122  break;
123  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::Add:
124  Put('+');
125  break;
126  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::Subtract:
127  Put('-');
128  break;
129  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::Concat:
130  Put("//");
131  break;
132  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::LT:
133  Put('<');
134  break;
135  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::LE:
136  Put("<=");
137  break;
138  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::EQ:
139  Put("==");
140  break;
141  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::NE:
142  Put("/=");
143  break;
144  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::GE:
145  Put(">=");
146  break;
147  case DefinedOperator::IntrinsicOperator::GT:
148  Put('>');
149  break;
150  default:
151  Put('.'), Word(DefinedOperator::EnumToString(x)), Put('.');
152  }
153  }

197  void Unparse(/*const*/ KindSelector &x) { // R706
198  common::visit(
199  common::visitors{
200  [&](const ScalarIntConstantExpr &y) {
201  Put('('), Word("KIND="), Walk(y), Put(')');
202  },
203  [&](const KindSelector::StarSize &y) { Put('*'), Walk(y.v); },
204  },
205  x.u);
206  }

208  Put(std::get<CharBlock>(x.t).ToString());
209  Walk("_", std::get<std::optional<KindParam>>(x.t));
210  }

212  Put(std::get<CharBlock>(x.t).ToString());
213  Walk("_", std::get<std::optional<KindParam>>(x.t));
214  }

216  Put(x == Sign::Negative ? '-' : '+');
217  }

219  Put(x.real.source.ToString()), Walk("_", x.kind);
220  }

231  Put('('), Word("LEN="), Walk(y), Put(')');

238  common::visit(
239  common::visitors{
240  [&](const TypeParamValue &y) { Put('('), Walk(y), Put(')'); },
241  [&](const std::int64_t &y) { Walk(y); },
242  },
243  x.u);

245  void Unparse(/*const*/ CharLiteralConstant &x) { // R724
246  const auto &str{std::get<std::string>(x.t)};
247  if (const auto &k{std::get<std::optional<KindParam>>(x.t)}) {
248  Walk(*k), Put('_');
249  }

255  Unparse(ucs.size());

282  Word("EXTENDS("), Walk(x.v), Put(')');

290  void Unparse(/*const*/ TypeParamDefStmt &x) { // R732
291  Walk(std::get<IntegerTypeSpec>(x.t));
292  Put(", "), Walk(std::get<common::TypeParamAttr>(x.t));
293  Put(" :: "), Walk(std::get<std::list<TypeParamDecl>>(x.t), ", ");

295  void Unparse(/*const*/ TypeParamDecl &x) { // R733
296  Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t));
297  Walk("=", std::get<std::optional<ScalarIntConstantExpr>>(x.t));
298  }
299  void Unparse(/*const*/ DataComponentDefStmt &x) { // R737
300  const auto &dts{std::get<DeclarationTypeSpec>(x.t)};
301  const auto &attrs{std::get<std::list<ComponentAttrSpec>>(x.t)};
302  const auto &decls{std::get<std::list<ComponentOrFill>>(x.t)};
303  Walk(dts), Walk(", ", attrs, ", ");
304  if (!attrs.empty() ||
305  (!std::holds_alternative<DeclarationTypeSpec::Record>(dts.u) &&
306  std::none_of(
307  decls.begin(), decls.end(), [](const ComponentOrFill &c) {
308  return common::visit(
309  common::visitors{
310  [](const ComponentDecl &d) {
311  const auto &init{
312  std::get<std::optional<Initialization>>(d.t)};
313  return init &&
314  std::holds_alternative<std::list<
315  common::Indirection<DataStmtValue>>>(
316  init->u);
317  },
318  [](const FillDecl &) { return false; },
319  },
320  c.u);
321  }))) {
322  Put(" ::");
323  }
324  Put(' '), Walk(decls, ", ");
325  }
326  void Unparse(/*const*/ Allocatable &) { // R738
327  Word("ALLOCATABLE");
328  }
329  void Unparse(/*const*/ Pointer &) { Word("POINTER"); }
330  void Unparse(/*const*/ Contiguous &) { Word("CONTIGUOUS"); }
331  void Before(const ComponentAttrSpec &x) {
332  common::visit(common::visitors{
333  [&](const CoarraySpec &) { Word("CODIMENSION["); },
334  [&](const ComponentArraySpec &) { Word("DIMENSION("); },
335  [](const auto &) {},
336  },
337  x.u);
338  }
339  void Post(const ComponentAttrSpec &x) {
340  common::visit(common::visitors{
341  [&](const CoarraySpec &) { Put(']'); },
342  [&](const ComponentArraySpec &) { Put(')'); },
343  [](const auto &) {},
344  },
345  x.u);
346  }
347  void Unparse(/*const*/ ComponentDecl &x) { // R739
348  Walk(std::get<ObjectName>(x.t));
349  Walk("(", std::get<std::optional<ComponentArraySpec>>(x.t), ")");
350  Walk("[", std::get<std::optional<CoarraySpec>>(x.t), "]");
351  Walk("*", std::get<std::optional<CharLength>>(x.t));
352  Walk(std::get<std::optional<Initialization>>(x.t));
353  }
354  void Unparse(/*const*/ FillDecl &x) { // DEC extension
355  Put("%FILL");
356  Walk("(", std::get<std::optional<ComponentArraySpec>>(x.t), ")");
357  Walk("*", std::get<std::optional<CharLength>>(x.t));
358  }
359  void Unparse(/*const*/ ComponentArraySpec &x) { // R740
360  common::visit(
361  common::visitors{
362  [&](const std::list<ExplicitShapeSpec> &y) { Walk(y, ","); },
363  [&](const DeferredShapeSpecList &y) { Walk(y); },
364  },
365  x.u);
366  }
367  void Unparse(/*const*/ ProcComponentDefStmt &x) { // R741
368  Word("PROCEDURE(");
369  Walk(std::get<std::optional<ProcInterface>>(x.t)), Put(')');
370  Walk(", ", std::get<std::list<ProcComponentAttrSpec>>(x.t), ", ");
371  Put(" :: "), Walk(std::get<std::list<ProcDecl>>(x.t), ", ");
372  }

374  Word("NOPASS");

376  void Unparse(/*const*/ Pass &x) { Word("PASS"), Walk("(", x.v, ")"); }
377  void Unparse(/*const*/ Initialization &x) { // R743 & R805
378  common::visit(
379  common::visitors{
380  [&](const ConstantExpr &y) { Put(" = "), Walk(y); },
381  [&](const NullInit &y) { Put(" => "), Walk(y); },
382  [&](const InitialDataTarget &y) { Put(" => "), Walk(y); },
383  [&](const std::list<common::Indirection<DataStmtValue>> &y) {
384  Walk("/", y, ", ", "/");
385  },
386  },
387  x.u);

394  Put(" :: "), Walk(x.declarations, ", ");

398  Walk(x.attributes);

404  }

407  Put(" :: "), Walk(std::get<common::Indirection<GenericSpec>>(x.t));
408  Put(" => "), Walk(std::get<std::list<Name>>(x.t), ", ");
409  }

458  Walk(x.name), Put('='), Walk(x.lower), Put(','), Walk(x.upper);
459  Walk(",", x.step);

463  Put(", "), Walk(std::get<AcImpliedDoControl>(x.t)), Put(')');
464  }

470  void Unparse(/*const*/ TypeDeclarationStmt &x) { // R801
471  const auto &dts{std::get<DeclarationTypeSpec>(x.t)};
472  const auto &attrs{std::get<std::list<AttrSpec>>(x.t)};
473  const auto &decls{std::get<std::list<EntityDecl>>(x.t)};
474  Walk(dts), Walk(", ", attrs, ", ");
475 
476  static const auto isInitializerOldStyle{[](const Initialization &i) {
477  return std::holds_alternative<
478  std::list<common::Indirection<DataStmtValue>>>(i.u);
479  }};
480  static const auto hasAssignmentInitializer{[](const EntityDecl &d) {
481  // Does a declaration have a new-style =x initializer?
482  const auto &init{std::get<std::optional<Initialization>>(d.t)};
483  return init && !isInitializerOldStyle(*init);
484  }};
485  static const auto hasSlashDelimitedInitializer{[](const EntityDecl &d) {
486  // Does a declaration have an old-style /x/ initializer?
487  const auto &init{std::get<std::optional<Initialization>>(d.t)};
488  return init && isInitializerOldStyle(*init);
489  }};
490  const auto useDoubledColons{[&]() {
491  bool isRecord{std::holds_alternative<DeclarationTypeSpec::Record>(dts.u)};
492  if (!attrs.empty()) {
493  // Attributes after the type require :: before the entities.
494  CHECK(!isRecord);
495  return true;
496  }
497  if (std::any_of(decls.begin(), decls.end(), hasAssignmentInitializer)) {
498  // Always use :: with new style standard initializers (=x),
499  // since the standard requires them to appear (even in free form,
500  // where mandatory spaces already disambiguate INTEGER J=666).
501  CHECK(!isRecord);
502  return true;
503  }
504  if (isRecord) {
505  // Never put :: in a legacy extension RECORD// statement.
506  return false;
507  }
508  // The :: is optional for this declaration. Avoid usage that can
509  // crash the pgf90 compiler.
510  if (std::any_of(
511  decls.begin(), decls.end(), hasSlashDelimitedInitializer)) {
512  // Don't use :: when a declaration uses legacy DATA-statement-like
513  // /x/ initialization.
514  return false;
515  }
516  // Don't use :: with intrinsic types. Otherwise, use it.
517  return !std::holds_alternative<IntrinsicTypeSpec>(dts.u);
518  }};
519 
520  if (useDoubledColons()) {
521  Put(" ::");
522  }
523  Put(' '), Walk(std::get<std::list<EntityDecl>>(x.t), ", ");
524  }
525  void Before(const AttrSpec &x) { // R802
526  common::visit(common::visitors{
527  [&](const CoarraySpec &) { Word("CODIMENSION["); },
528  [&](const ArraySpec &) { Word("DIMENSION("); },
529  [](const auto &) {},
530  },
531  x.u);
532  }
533  void Post(const AttrSpec &x) {
534  common::visit(common::visitors{
535  [&](const CoarraySpec &) { Put(']'); },
536  [&](const ArraySpec &) { Put(')'); },
537  [](const auto &) {},
538  },
539  x.u);
540  }
541  void Unparse(/*const*/ EntityDecl &x) { // R803
542  Walk(std::get<ObjectName>(x.t));
543  Walk("(", std::get<std::optional<ArraySpec>>(x.t), ")");
544  Walk("[", std::get<std::optional<CoarraySpec>>(x.t), "]");
545  Walk("*", std::get<std::optional<CharLength>>(x.t));
546  Walk(std::get<std::optional<Initialization>>(x.t));
547  }
548  void Unparse(/*const*/ NullInit &) { // R806
549  Word("NULL()");
550  }
551  void Unparse(/*const*/ LanguageBindingSpec &x) { // R808 & R1528
552  Word("BIND(C"), Walk(", NAME=", x.v), Put(')');
553  }
554  void Unparse(/*const*/ CoarraySpec &x) { // R809
555  common::visit(common::visitors{
556  [&](const DeferredCoshapeSpecList &y) { Walk(y); },
557  [&](const ExplicitCoshapeSpec &y) { Walk(y); },
558  },

1512  case format::IntrinsicTypeDataEditDesc::Kind::x: \

1516  FMT(B);
1517  FMT(O);

1520  FMT(E);
1521  FMT(EN);
1522  FMT(ES);

1539  void Unparse(/*const*/ format::ControlEditDesc &x) { // R1313, R1315-R1320
1540  switch (x.kind) {
1541  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::T:

1545  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::TL:
1546  Word("TL");
1547  Walk(x.count);
1548  break;
1549  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::TR:
1550  Word("TR");
1551  Walk(x.count);
1552  break;
1553  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::X:
1554  if (x.count != 1) {
1555  Walk(x.count);
1556  }
1557  Word("X");
1558  break;
1559  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::Slash:
1560  if (x.count != 1) {
1561  Walk(x.count);
1562  }
1563  Put('/');
1564  break;
1565  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::Colon:
1566  Put(':');
1567  break;
1568  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::P:
1569  Walk(x.count);
1570  Word("P");
1571  break;
1572 #define FMT(x) \
1573  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::x: \
1574  Put(#x); \
1575  break
1576  FMT(SS);
1577  FMT(SP);
1578  FMT(S);
1579  FMT(BN);
1580  FMT(BZ);
1581  FMT(RU);
1582  FMT(RD);
1583  FMT(RZ);
1584  FMT(RN);
1585  FMT(RC);
1586  FMT(RP);
1587  FMT(DC);
1588  FMT(DP);
1589 #undef FMT
1590  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::Dollar:
1591  Put('$');
1592  break;
1593  case format::ControlEditDesc::Kind::Backslash:
1594  Put('\\');
1595  break;
1596  }

1626  common::visit(common::visitors{
1627  [&](const Rename::Names &y) { Walk(y.t, " => "); },
1628  [&](const Rename::Operators &y) {
1629  Word("OPERATOR("), Walk(y.t, ") => OPERATOR("),
1630  Put(")");
1631  },
1632  },
1633  x.u);
1634  }

1636  Word("SUBMODULE ("), WalkTupleElements(x.t, ")"), Indent();
1637  }

1639  Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t)), Walk(":", std::get<std::optional<Name>>(x.t));
1640  }

1642  EndSubprogram("SUBMODULE", x.v);
1643  }
1644  void Unparse(/*const*/ BlockDataStmt &x) { // R1421
1645  Word("BLOCK DATA"), Walk(" ", x.v), Indent();
1646  }
1647  void Unparse(/*const*/ EndBlockDataStmt &x) { // R1422
1648  EndSubprogram("BLOCK DATA", x.v);
1649  }

1651  void Unparse(/*const*/ InterfaceStmt &x) { // R1503
1652  common::visit(common::visitors{
1653  [&](const std::optional<GenericSpec> &y) {
1654  Word("INTERFACE"), Walk(" ", y);
1655  },
1656  [&](const Abstract &) { Word("ABSTRACT INTERFACE"); },
1657  },
1658  x.u);
1659  Indent();
1660  }
1661  void Unparse(/*const*/ EndInterfaceStmt &x) { // R1504
1662  Outdent(), Word("END INTERFACE"), Walk(" ", x.v);
1663  }
1664  void Unparse(/*const*/ ProcedureStmt &x) { // R1506
1665  if (std::get<ProcedureStmt::Kind>(x.t) ==
1666  ProcedureStmt::Kind::ModuleProcedure) {
1667  Word("MODULE ");
1668  }
1669  Word("PROCEDURE :: ");
1670  Walk(std::get<std::list<Name>>(x.t), ", ");
1671  }
1672  void Before(const GenericSpec &x) { // R1508, R1509
1673  common::visit(
1674  common::visitors{
1675  [&](const DefinedOperator &) { Word("OPERATOR("); },
1676  [&](const GenericSpec::Assignment &) { Word("ASSIGNMENT(=)"); },
1677  [&](const GenericSpec::ReadFormatted &) {
1678  Word("READ(FORMATTED)");
1679  },
1680  [&](const GenericSpec::ReadUnformatted &) {
1681  Word("READ(UNFORMATTED)");
1682  },
1683  [&](const GenericSpec::WriteFormatted &) {
1684  Word("WRITE(FORMATTED)");
1685  },
1686  [&](const GenericSpec::WriteUnformatted &) {
1687  Word("WRITE(UNFORMATTED)");
1688  },
1689  [](const auto &) {},
1690  },
1691  x.u);
1692  }
1693  void Post(const GenericSpec &x) {
1694  common::visit(common::visitors{
1695  [&](const DefinedOperator &) { Put(')'); },
1696  [](const auto &) {},
1697  },
1698  x.u);
1699  }
1700  void Unparse(/*const*/ GenericStmt &x) { // R1510
1701  Word("GENERIC"), Walk(", ", std::get<std::optional<AccessSpec>>(x.t));
1702  Put(" :: "), Walk(std::get<GenericSpec>(x.t)), Put(" => ");
1703  Walk(std::get<std::list<Name>>(x.t), ", ");
1704  }
1705 #if PUT
1706  void Unparse(/*const*/ ExternalStmt &x) { // R1511
1707  Word("EXTERNAL :: "), Walk(x.v, ", ");
1708  }
1709 #endif
1710  void Unparse(/*const*/ ProcedureDeclarationStmt &x) { // R1512
1711  Word("PROCEDURE("), Walk(std::get<std::optional<ProcInterface>>(x.t));
1712  Put(')'), Walk(", ", std::get<std::list<ProcAttrSpec>>(x.t), ", ");
1713  Put(" :: "), Walk(std::get<std::list<ProcDecl>>(x.t), ", ");
1714  }
1715  void Unparse(/*const*/ ProcDecl &x) { // R1515
1716  Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t));
1717  Walk(" => ", std::get<std::optional<ProcPointerInit>>(x.t));
1718  }
1719  void Unparse(/*const*/ IntrinsicStmt &x) { // R1519
1720  Word("INTRINSIC :: "), Walk(x.v, ", ");
1721  }
1722  void Unparse(/*const*/ CallStmt::Chevrons &x) { // CUDA
1723  Walk(std::get<0>(x.t)); // grid
1724  Word(","), Walk(std::get<1>(x.t)); // block
1725  Walk(",", std::get<2>(x.t)); // bytes
1726  Walk(",", std::get<3>(x.t)); // stream
1727  }
1728  void Unparse(/*const*/ FunctionReference &x) { // R1520
1729  Walk(std::get<ProcedureDesignator>(x.v.t));
1730  Put('('), Walk(std::get<std::list<ActualArgSpec>>(x.v.t), ", "), Put(')');
1731  }
1732  void Unparse(/*const*/ CallStmt &x) { // R1521
1733  if (asFortran_ && x.typedCall.get()) {
1734  Put(' ');
1735  asFortran_->call(out_, *x.typedCall);
1736  Put('\n');
1737  } else {
1738  const auto &pd{std::get<ProcedureDesignator>(x.call.t)};
1739  Word("CALL "), Walk(pd);
1740  Walk("<<<", x.chevrons, ">>>");
1741  const auto &args{std::get<std::list<ActualArgSpec>>(x.call.t)};
1742  if (args.empty()) {
1743  if (std::holds_alternative<ProcComponentRef>(pd.u)) {
1744  Put("()"); // pgf90 crashes on CALL to tbp without parentheses
1745  }
1746  } else {
1747  Walk("(", args, ", ", ")");
1748  }
1749  }
1750  }
1751  void Unparse(/*const*/ ActualArgSpec &x) { // R1523
1752  Walk(std::get<std::optional<Keyword>>(x.t), "=");
1753  Walk(std::get<ActualArg>(x.t));
1754  }
1755  void Unparse(/*const*/ ActualArg::PercentRef &x) { // R1524
1756  Word("%REF("), Walk(x.v), Put(')');
1757  }
1758  void Unparse(/*const*/ ActualArg::PercentVal &x) {
1759  Word("%VAL("), Walk(x.v), Put(')');
1760  }
1761  void Before(const AltReturnSpec &) { // R1525
1762  Put('*');
1763  }
1764  void Post(const PrefixSpec::Elemental) { Word("ELEMENTAL"); } // R1527
1765  void Post(const PrefixSpec::Impure) { Word("IMPURE"); }
1766  void Post(const PrefixSpec::Module) { Word("MODULE"); }
1767  void Post(const PrefixSpec::Non_Recursive) { Word("NON_RECURSIVE"); }
1768  void Post(const PrefixSpec::Pure) { Word("PURE"); }
1769  void Post(const PrefixSpec::Recursive) { Word("RECURSIVE"); }
1770  void Unparse(/*const*/ PrefixSpec::Attributes &x) {
1771  Word("ATTRIBUTES("), Walk(x.v), Word(")");
1772  }

1774  Word("LAUNCH_BOUNDS("), Walk(x.v), Word(")");
1775  }

1779  void Unparse(/*const*/ FunctionStmt &x) { // R1530
1780  Walk("", std::get<std::list<PrefixSpec>>(x.t), " ", " ");
1781  Word("FUNCTION "), Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t)), Put("(");
1782  Walk(std::get<std::list<Name>>(x.t), ", "), Put(')');
1783  Walk(" ", std::get<std::optional<Suffix>>(x.t)), Indent();
1784  }
1785  void Unparse(/*const*/ Suffix &x) { // R1532
1786  if (x.resultName) {
1787  Word("RESULT("), Walk(x.resultName), Put(')');
1788  Walk(" ", x.binding);
1789  } else {
1790  Walk(x.binding);
1791  }
1792  }
1793  void Unparse(/*const*/ EndFunctionStmt &x) { // R1533
1794  EndSubprogram("FUNCTION", x.v);
1795  }
1796  void Unparse(/*const*/ SubroutineStmt &x) { // R1535
1797  Walk("", std::get<std::list<PrefixSpec>>(x.t), " ", " ");
1798  Word("SUBROUTINE "), Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t));
1799  const auto &args{std::get<std::list<DummyArg>>(x.t)};
1800  const auto &bind{std::get<std::optional<LanguageBindingSpec>>(x.t)};
1801  if (args.empty()) {
1802  Walk(" () ", bind);
1803  } else {
1804  Walk(" (", args, ", ", ")");
1805  Walk(" ", bind);
1806  }
1807  Indent();
1808  }
1809  void Unparse(/*const*/ EndSubroutineStmt &x) { // R1537
1810  EndSubprogram("SUBROUTINE", x.v);
1811  }
1812  void Before(const MpSubprogramStmt &) { // R1539
1813  Word("MODULE PROCEDURE "), Indent();
1814  }
1815  void Unparse(/*const*/ EndMpSubprogramStmt &x) { // R1540
1816  EndSubprogram("PROCEDURE", x.v);
1817  }
1818  void Unparse(/*const*/ EntryStmt &x) { // R1541
1819  Word("ENTRY "), Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t)), Put("(");
1820  Walk(std::get<std::list<DummyArg>>(x.t), ", "), Put(")");
1821  Walk(" ", std::get<std::optional<Suffix>>(x.t));

1832  Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t)), Put('(');
1833  Walk(std::get<std::list<Name>>(x.t), ", "), Put(") = ");
1834  Walk(std::get<Scalar<Expr>>(x.t));
1835  }

1837  // Directives, extensions, and deprecated constructs
1838  void Unparse(/*const*/ CompilerDirective &x) {
1839  common::visit(
1840  common::visitors{
1841  [&](const std::list<CompilerDirective::IgnoreTKR> &tkr) {
1842  Word("!DIR$ IGNORE_TKR"); // emitted even if tkr list is empty
1843  Walk(" ", tkr, ", ");
1844  },
1845  [&](const CompilerDirective::LoopCount &lcount) {
1846  Walk("!DIR$ LOOP COUNT (", lcount.v, ", ", ")");
1847  },
1848  [&](const std::list<CompilerDirective::NameValue> &names) {
1849  Walk("!DIR$ ", names, " ");
1850  },
1851  },
1852  x.u);
1853  Put('\n');
1854  }
1855  void Unparse(/*const*/ CompilerDirective::IgnoreTKR &x) {
1856  if (const auto &maybeList{
1857  std::get<std::optional<std::list<const char *>>>(x.t)}) {
1858  Put("(");
1859  for (const char *tkr : *maybeList) {
1860  Put(*tkr);
1861  }
1862  Put(") ");
1863  }
1864  Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t));
1865  }
1866  void Unparse(/*const*/ CompilerDirective::NameValue &x) {
1867  Walk(std::get<Name>(x.t));
1868  Walk("=", std::get<std::optional<std::uint64_t>>(x.t));
1869  }

2748  void Unparse(const CUFKernelDoConstruct::Directive &x) {
2749  Word("!$CUF KERNEL DO");
2750  Walk(" (", std::get<std::optional<ScalarIntConstantExpr>>(x.t), ")");
2751  Word(" <<<");
2752  const auto &grid{std::get<1>(x.t)};
2753  if (grid.empty()) {
2754  Word("*");
2755  } else if (grid.size() == 1) {
2756  Walk(grid.front());
2757  } else {
2758  Walk("(", grid, ",", ")");
2759  }
2760  Word(",");
2761  const auto &block{std::get<2>(x.t)};
2762  if (block.empty()) {
2763  Word("*");
2764  } else if (block.size() == 1) {
2765  Walk(block.front());
2766  } else {
2767  Walk("(", block, ",", ")");
2768  }
2769  if (const auto &stream{std::get<3>(x.t)}) {
2770  Word(",STREAM="), Walk(*stream);
2771  }
2772  Word(">>>\n");
2773  }
2774 
2775  void Unparse(const CUFKernelDoConstruct &x) {
2776  Walk(std::get<CUFKernelDoConstruct::Directive>(x.t));
2777  Walk(std::get<std::optional<DoConstruct>>(x.t));
2778  }

2781 #if 0
2782  { CHECK(indent_ == 0); }

2813  // Call back to the traversal framework.
2814  template <typename T> void Walk(const T &x) {
2815  Fortran::parser::Walk(x, *this);
2816  }
2817 
2818  // Traverse a std::optional<> value. Emit a prefix and/or a suffix string
2819  // only when it contains a value.
2820  template <typename A>
2821  void Walk(
2822  const char *prefix, const std::optional<A> &x, const char *suffix = "") {
2823  if (x) {
2824  Word(prefix), Walk(*x), Word(suffix);
2825  }
2826  }
2827  template <typename A>
2828  void Walk(const std::optional<A> &x, const char *suffix = "") {
2829  return Walk("", x, suffix);
2830  }
2831 
2832  // Traverse a std::list<>. Separate the elements with an optional string.
2833  // Emit a prefix and/or a suffix string only when the list is not empty.
2834  template <typename A>
2835  void Walk(const char *prefix, const std::list<A> &list,
2836  const char *comma = ", ", const char *suffix = "") {
2837  if (!list.empty()) {
2838  const char *str{prefix};
2839  for (const auto &x : list) {
2840  Word(str), Walk(x);
2841  str = comma;
2842  }
2843  Word(suffix);
2844  }
2845  }
2846  template <typename A>
2847  void Walk(const std::list<A> &list, const char *comma = ", ",
2848  const char *suffix = "") {
2849  return Walk("", list, comma, suffix);
2850  }
2851 
2852  // Traverse a std::tuple<>, with an optional separator.
2853  template <std::size_t J = 0, typename T>
2854  void WalkTupleElements(const T &tuple, const char *separator) {
2855  if (J > 0 && J < std::tuple_size_v<T>) {
2856  Word(separator); // this usage dodges "unused parameter" warning
2857  }
2858  if constexpr (J < std::tuple_size_v<T>) {
2859  Walk(std::get<J>(tuple));
2860  WalkTupleElements<J + 1>(tuple, separator);
2861  }
2862  }
2863  template <typename... A>
2864  void Walk(const std::tuple<A...> &tuple, const char *separator = "") {
2865  WalkTupleElements(tuple, separator);
2866  }
2867 
2868  void EndSubprogram(const char *kind, const std::optional<Name> &name) {
2869  Outdent(), Word("END "), Word(kind), Walk(" ", name);
2870  structureComponents_.clear();
2871  }
2872 
2873  llvm::raw_ostream &out_;
2874  int indent_{0};
2875  const int indentationAmount_{1};
2876  int column_{1};
2877  const int maxColumns_{80};
2878  std::set<CharBlock> structureComponents_;
2879  Encoding encoding_{Encoding::UTF_8};
2880  bool capitalizeKeywords_{true};
2881  bool openaccDirective_{false};
2882  bool openmpDirective_{false};
2883  bool backslashEscapes_{false};
2884  preStatementType *preStatement_{nullptr};
2885  AnalyzedObjectsAsFortran *asFortran_{nullptr};
2886 
2887 //erasmus
2888  Fortran::parser::AllCookedSources* cooked_{nullptr};
2889 };

2891 void UnparseSageVisitor::Put(char ch) {
2892  int sav = indent_;
2893  if (openmpDirective_ || openaccDirective_) {
2894  indent_ = 0;
2895  }
2896  if (column_ <= 1) {
2897  if (ch == '\n') {
2898  return;
2899  }
2900  for (int j{0}; j < indent_; ++j) {
2901  out_ << ' ';
2902  }
2903  column_ = indent_ + 2;
2904  } else if (ch == '\n') {
2905  column_ = 1;
2906  } else if (++column_ >= maxColumns_) {
2907  out_ << "&\n";
2908  for (int j{0}; j < indent_; ++j) {
2909  out_ << ' ';
2910  }
2911  if (openmpDirective_) {
2912  out_ << "!$OMP&";
2913  column_ = 8;
2914  } else if (openaccDirective_) {
2915  out_ << "!$ACC&";
2916  column_ = 8;
2917  } else {
2918  out_ << '&';
2919  column_ = indent_ + 3;
2920  }
2921  }
2922  out_ << ch;
2923  if (openmpDirective_ || openaccDirective_) {
2924  indent_ = sav;
2925  }
2926 }
2927 
2928 void UnparseSageVisitor::Put(const char *str) {
2929  for (; *str != '\0'; ++str) {
2930  Put(*str);
2931  }
2932 }
2933 
2934 void UnparseSageVisitor::Put(const std::string &str) {
2935  for (char ch : str) {
2936  Put(ch);
2937  }
2938 }

2940 void UnparseSageVisitor::PutNormalized(const std::string &str) {
2941  auto decoded{DecodeString<std::string, Encoding::LATIN_1>(str, true)};
2942  std::string encoded{EncodeString<Encoding::LATIN_1>(decoded)};
2943  Put(QuoteCharacterLiteral(encoded, backslashEscapes_));
2944 }

2946 void UnparseSageVisitor::PutKeywordLetter(char ch) {

2950  Put(ToLowerCaseLetter(ch));
2951  }
2952 }
2953 
2954 void UnparseSageVisitor::Word(const char *str) {
2955  for (; *str != '\0'; ++str) {
2956  PutKeywordLetter(*str);
2957  }
2958 }

2960 void UnparseSageVisitor::Word(const std::string &str) { Word(str.c_str()); }

2962 void UnparseSageVisitor::Word(const std::string_view &str) {
2963  for (std::size_t j{0}; j < str.length(); ++j) {
2964  PutKeywordLetter(str[j]);
2965  }
2966 }
